question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(2)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses finding flexibility for frontline employees similar to those in the manufacturing and healthcare sectors.
 
• The** appropriate term **should indicate individuals who work on the front lines, typically referred to as** "workers."**
 
• "**Workers**" fits well as it encompasses those in various frontline roles such as in manufacturing and healthcare.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 2 is **'workers.'**

Therefore, the correct sentence from the passage should read** "i****t's time to find equitable flexibility for frontline workers like those in manufacturing and healthcare......"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Other options ("chasers", "bosses", "personal") do not fit the context of describing frontline employees adequately.

 
• **Chasers** (पीछा करने वाले): "Chasers" are those who pursue or follow something, which does not fit the context of describing frontline employees.
 
• **Bosses** (मालिक): "Bosses" refer to those in supervisory or managerial roles, which is not relevant in this context of discussing frontline workers.
 
• **Personal (**व्यक्तिगत): "Personal" is an adjective indicating something relating to an individual, not suitable for referring to a group of employees.
